# Text case converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/case-converter/

Change text to uppercase, lowercase, title or sentence case. Convert phrases into camelCase, snake\_case or kebab-case for coding and labels.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Turn a page title into a lowercase, hyphenated slug, or normalize an all-uppercase draft.

## Limits and checks

Automatic title and sentence case cannot infer proper nouns. Review names, acronyms and language-specific capitalization.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
